name: Mega Man Twin-Dish Interceptor
tagline: Mega-Blue Sidepods, Giant Rear Dish Tires & Elevated T-Collar Silver Bar
description: Sleek low-slung Mega-Man-Blue and mirror-chrome interceptor go-kart built on authentic Mega Man contraption hardware: giant 13.5u rear 5-ribbed pneumatic tires and nimble 8.8u front wheels on off-white stamped steel dish rims with zinc hex nuts, yellow cotter pins, and brass Schrader valves; underslung stainless cross-axles; cobalt-blue and cyan-trim side fairing pods with crisp white racing stripes; a prominent +3 deg mirror-chrome bullet-nosed silver torpedo bar clamped in an elevated stainless TIG T-collar gimbal ahead of the nose cowl; quilted blue/white bucket seat; stainless butterfly steering yoke; and twin angled Mega-Buster exhaust cannons.
highlights: Giant R=13.5u rear & R=8.8u front Mega Man 5-ribbed dish wheels w/ hex/cotter/valve
Mirror-chrome torpedo bar (X=+10..+56, +3 deg) in elevated TIG T-collar on twin struts
Angled chrome Mega-Buster exhaust cannons w/ cyan/white-hot shock-diamond plumes
